config.label: Your personal MDMagic API key (format: mdmagic-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX)
config.description: Your personal MDMagic API key (format: mdmagic-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX). Get yours at https://mdmagic.ai/account — the 'Connect to AI Assistants via MCP' card on your account page generates the key and pre-fills a copy-pasteable config block.

config.label: Override the MDMagic API base URL
config.description: Override the MDMagic API base URL. Defaults to https://api.mdmagic.ai. Only set this if you're running MDMagic against a local dev backend.

config.label: Request timeout in milliseconds
config.description: Request timeout in milliseconds. Increase for very large documents on slow connections. Default: 30000 (30s).

config.label: Transport mode: 'stdio' (default, for local clients like Claude Desktop) or 'http' (for self-hosted Streamable HTTP)
config.description: Transport mode: 'stdio' (default, for local clients like Claude Desktop) or 'http' (for self-hosted Streamable HTTP).

config.label: Port for HTTP transport mode
config.description: Port for HTTP transport mode. Default: 3001. Only used when MCP_TRANSPORT=http.

config.label: Bind address for HTTP transport mode
config.description: Bind address for HTTP transport mode. Default: 127.0.0.1. Only used when MCP_TRANSPORT=http.

config.label: Your personal MDMagic API key from https://mdmagic
config.description: Your personal MDMagic API key from https://mdmagic.ai/account
